      "text": "Based on the provided HTML history of the multiplayer room **\"BPM vs. the World || 7*| W3\"**, here is a comprehensive breakdown of the match, including estimated match costs, a consistency evaluation, and an overall analysis.\n\n### 📊 Estimated Match Costs \u0026 Player Tiers\n*Note: Because this was a dynamic open lobby with players rotating in and out, traditional Match Cost (MC) formulas are estimated here by evaluating each player\u0027s average score relative to the lobby\u0027s average on the maps they played.*\n\n**👑 The Heavy Hitters (MC 1.50+)**\n*   **DamjanLenc (~1.80 MC):** Joined late but completely terrorized the lobby. With maps like *Paradigm Shift*, *conflict*, *Tout Petit Moineau*, and *Cygnus*, this was a heavy test of stamina, high BPM tapping, and aim control. The massive disparities in scores (people getting 700k while others on the same team got 50k) highlight just how unforgiving 7* tech/speed maps are. If you can\u0027t read the patterns or lack the stamina, you fail spectacularly.\n\n**2.
